capabilities: Generate names from user lists with a local Markov model
Produce place, group, vehicle and object names via 50 modules
Insert selected names into notes as text, bullets or checklists
Save module setups as preset notes and reproduce batches from seeds
Store packs and presets as plain markdown files in the vault
disambiguation: Not a file or folder renamer; it generates fictional names for worldbuilding from user-supplied word lists.
extras: All generation runs locally and no names leave the vault; the README references external documentation files such as docs/people-tables.md.
motivation: The author says 'I built nameForge to help me with my storytelling' as a worldbuilder needing names for invented cultures and places.
problem: Writers and worldbuilders have no built-in way to generate consistent, style-matched fictional names for places, people, groups and things inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: In storyForge the main window of nameForge is added to the interface.

summary: Offline Markov-based name generator that learns letter patterns from user-supplied lists and produces fictional names for worldbuilding.
